curious.text: Is this good news for industry? In many ways, yes. But is it enough? That's the real question. Some experts are optimistic. Others are cautious.

emphatic.text: Here is what I think. The companies that move early will have a genuine advantage. Remember this: data first, decision second. Without reliable data, nothing else works.

explanatory.text: Decarbonisation means cutting emissions at source, through energy efficiency, electrification, fuel switching and renewable energy. An internal carbon price, a marginal abatement cost curve and a decarbonisation roadmap help prioritise investment.

warm.text: If you found this useful, subscribe to ReGeneva and share it with your team. Thank you for watching, and I will see you in the next one.
